evidence.why: The full typed definition explicitly enumerates accepted inputs and separates them from the assertion branch.

facts.rationale: Preserves the source-confirmed types and accepted domain while removing the unsupported total-function characterization.
facts.value: Signature: GXTexGenSrc HSD_TexCoordID2TexGenSrc(GXTexCoordID coord). The supported conversion domain is GX_TEXCOORD0 through GX_TEXCOORD6, returning the corresponding GX_TG_TEXCOORD0 through GX_TG_TEXCOORD6. GX_TEXCOORD7 and other inputs enter HSD_ASSERT; the function has a trailing syntactic GX_TG_TEXCOORD0 fallback.

evidence.why: Constant backing fields and color-only immediate/texture sources.
Remaining color cases, complete alpha switch and independently configured operations.

facts.rationale: The complete switches establish distinct color and alpha source sets; the constant constructors point to stored configuration fields rather than reading live hardware registers.
facts.value: Constructs a texture object's optional custom TEV color and alpha expressions with independently configured operations. Each color input supports zero, one, half, texture RGB or alpha, konst RGB or replicated components, and stored tev0/tev1 RGB or alpha. Each alpha input supports zero, texture alpha, konst scalar components, and stored tev0/tev1 alpha; it does not support the color-only one, half or texture-RGB selectors. Stored tev0/tev1 fields become constant expressions routed through auxiliary pass-through stages.
